escena: SCENE (a set being rigged, warehouse in Lima, late afternoon): she wears the Efeonce team polo and the Efeonce cap — field register. NO EMBROIDERED EMBLEM IS VISIBLE ON EITHER GARMENT — verify it by these landmarks: the cap is seen from BEHIND AND SLIGHTLY TO THE SIDE, so its front panel faces away from the lens entirely, and her chest is turned away with her raised arm crossing in front of it; no part of the cap or the polo carries a readable mark. A steel rail crosses the RIGHT half of the frame in a hard diagonal, sharp along its whole length, passing in front of her WITHOUT covering her. A hard low sun beam comes from the right and lights her and the dust in the air; the reserved brick wall down the LEFT side stays in its own even shadow, nothing crossing it. A large AZURE-BLUE lighting panel stands lit in the right background. An ORANGE strip of marking tape runs along the floor at the right edge. Caught AT THE INSTANT she locks a clamp shut. 35mm at f/4.
